maya: Heads up — SageWorks invoice landed in AP flagged as 'needs approver' but the PO doesn't match our buyer entity. Can someone look?
kevin: Which invoice/PO numbers?
maya: Invoice `45817`, PO `98012`. PDF shows PO tied to SageWorks (UK) but our contract and PR were under SageWorks (US).
linda: :eyes: That explains routing. Our approver rules route by vendor legal_entity_id. Looks like vendor record has wrong country tag.
accounts-bot: System: Invoice 45817 created and assigned status NEEDS_APPROVER by AP ingestion (batch 2026-03-23T14:07:14Z).
kevin: I can reroute manually but need GL code and cost center. maya: GL should be `6002` (Cloud infra) and cost center `ENG-PLATFORM` — confirmed by PR.
linda: I'll update vendor master after Kevin confirms reroute so future invoices go to the right approver. Also logging a short audit note.
kevin: Done — I changed approver to `eng-purchasing@redwood.com` and set status to PENDING_APPROVAL. Added note: "Rerouted due to vendor legal_entity mismatch; vendor master updated 2026-03-23."
maya: Thanks! Can you paste the AP admin URL so I can attach the audit to the PR?
kevin: https://ap.redwood.internal/invoices/45817 — attached note and PDF.
linda: I'll flip vendor record to SageWorks (US) and add a migration task to fix any other invoices that landed in the UK bucket.
maya: Great. Also flagging vendor for a quick vendor master cleanup run tomorrow. :handshake:
kevin: Leaving a reminder in #finance for 10:00am tomorrow to run vendor dedupe.
accounts-bot: Audit: User kevin updated invoice 45817 status PENDING_APPROVAL at 2026-03-23T14:09:20Z.
maya: All set from my side. Thanks both.
kevin: np :thumbsup:
linda: Closing thread after vendor master change complete.
maya: Closing.
